turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Sure! For regular verbs in the past we add -ed. Example: play becomes played, and visit becomes visited. We use it for finished actions like last weekend.

Try this one. Write the past form: Yesterday I ___ (watch) a film.
